CC Series: Cortech Kangaroo All Purpose Delivery Cart
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-kangaroo-cart
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/facilities-maintenance/kangaroo-cart/
Spec sheet: Kangaroo Cart and lid
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Kangaroo All Purpose Delivery Cart
Current H1: Cortech Kangaroo Cart
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded 15-Bushel Cart for Laundry, Trash, and Material Handling, in Three Materials
Current subtitle: Cortech USA CC200, CC783, CC680, CC280, CC720, CC620, CC2, CC116 Kangaroo Cart
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Kangaroo All Purpose Delivery Cart is a heavy-duty molded cart for laundry collection and delivery, trash and recycling, food processing, janitorial work, and general material handling. It has a 1,000 lb load rating and a 15-bushel capacity, and it can be used indoors or outdoors.
The cart is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene. It rolls on heavy duty casters secured with stainless steel, tamper-resistant hardware, has push-pull handles on both sides, and has a drain plug for easy cleaning. It is made three ways: flame retardant, general use, and 100% recycled material.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene
Dimensions: 53”L×31”W×38”H
Weight: 52 lbs
Capacity: 1,000 lb load rating; 15-bushel capacity
Casters: Heavy duty casters secured with stainless steel, tamper-resistant hardware
Handles: Push-pull handles on both sides that also accommodate utility use
Drain Plug: Drain plug for easy cleaning
Material Options: Flame retardant (passes California Technical Bulletin 133), general use, or 100% recycled (Repro Black)
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Passes UL 94 HB
Indoor or Outdoor Use: Suitable for indoor or outdoor use
Lid: Kangaroo Cart lid sold separately
Warranty: 10-year factory warranty
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
CC200 – Blue Gray: Flame retardant
CC783 – Green: Flame retardant
CC680 – Blue: Flame retardant
CC280 – Gray: General use
CC720 – Green: General use
CC620 – Blue: General use
CC2 – White: General use
CC116 – Repro Black: 100% recycled material
Installation and Options
Assembly: Hardware bit size is T35
[H2] Applications
The Kangaroo Cart suits facilities that move laundry, trash, and supplies every day and need a cart that will not dent, rust, or break.
Typical applications include:
Laundry collection and delivery in correctional facilities, hospitals, and behavioral healthcare facilities
Trash and recycling collection
Janitorial work, food processing, and general material handling
Explore Anchortex's Prison Janitorial and Sanitation Supplies and Hospital Laundry Carts and Heavy Duty Basket Trucks collections for more carts and sanitation supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Facilities Maintenance
Cortech facilities maintenance products are molded to stand up to hard daily use in correctional facilities, behavioral healthcare facilities, and other high-abuse settings.
Cortech facilities maintenance includes:
Trash Receptacles: Cobra Cans in 20 to 55 gallon sizes, in flame retardant or food grade and general use material, and Cobra Mini Cans in 10 and 14 quart sizes
Can Dollies: Cobra Can dollies in two sizes
Carts: Kangaroo Carts and lids for laundry, trash, and material handling
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (55 characters): Cortech Kangaroo All Purpose Delivery Cart at Anchortex
Meta description (152 characters): Shop the Cortech Kangaroo Cart. A one-piece molded 15-bushel cart with a 1,000 lb load rating for laundry, trash, and material handling, indoors or out.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Facilities Maintenance" is a new section for the Cobra Can, Cobra Mini Can, can dolly, and Kangaroo Cart pages. It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: Cortech calls it the Kangaroo All Purpose Delivery Cart, so I added "All Purpose Delivery." There are eight models, so I left the model numbers out of the H1.
Weight: your variants are set to 255 lbs, which looks like a placeholder. The Cortech spec sheet says 52 lbs, so I used that.
Variant names: your variants say "Food Grade Material" for CC2, CC720, CC280, and CC620. The Cortech spec sheet calls these "General Use." Would you like them renamed, for example "CC2 - White General Use Material"? Your CC200 variant says "Blue/Gray"; Cortech says "Blue Gray."
Materials: the flame retardant cart passes Cal 133. The spec sheet does not say the general use or recycled carts pass it, so I wrote Cal 133 only for the flame retardant option.
Indoor or outdoor use: the Cortech spec sheet says the cart is for "Indoor or Outdoor Use."
Collection links: the cart is in your Prison Janitorial and Sanitation Supplies and Hospital Laundry Carts collections, so I linked those two.
I left out "Handles and bottom can be field-drilled for additional drain holes," "beverage service container (manufactured with insulated material)," and ".200 nominal wall thickness," since the Cortech spec sheet does not say these.
Product images: the page has one image. The Cortech product page has the same photo. I did not find other Kangaroo Cart photos.
